decisions.reason: This position covers site setup, temporary equipment, logistics, and site clearance. It does not require the purchase of new physical goods.
The deliverable is a piping and instrumentation diagram, not physical equipment.
The deliverable is a wall-mounted overview diagram. The backing or frame and hangers are included in its presentation, not ordered separately.
The position covers site measurements and the preparation and updating of drawings, plans, and schedules.
The position requires technical documentation and functional specifications for the electrical contractor, not electrical equipment.
The position covers as-built documentation, operating instructions, and a staff briefing. Binders and digital media are part of the document delivery.
The contractor must supply and install new plastic identification signs, including their holders.

items.material_name: Plastic plant identification sign with slide-in label holder and transparent cover, minimum 10 x 5 cm, minimum 7 mm lettering
items.description: UV-stable, scratch-resistant sign with black lettering on white, resistant to chemicals and temperature extremes.
